## Requirements
Requirement id to satisfy + stamp: **R-2.1.5** (§8.1) — provenance & authority model.
Tier **C0/Must**; `authority` enforced at C0, `taint`/`readers` carried at C0 (ADR-0033 D4).
C0/Stage-1 slice (§8.1 #9): `ProvenanceRecord` (`origin, authority, scope, created_at,
derived_from` + carried `taint`/`readers`/`attestation`); the seven `AuthorityClass` values;
`default_authority`; `join`/`meet`/`leq`; R-TEXT; IR validation errors (`MissingProvenance`);
ledger stamping on the mandatory classes (mandatory-provenance event table + append-time check);
P1, P6, the P7 lowering carrier; RP; the `seal` basis; monitor checks 1, 2, 5, 7.

## Acceptance criteria
Gating (§8.1 #7 / §9.2), deterministic: **AC-R-2.1.5-{1–2}**.
- AC-1: every HIR node/edge and every mandatory-table event carries a `ProvenanceRecord`;
  `validate`/`append` fail `MissingProvenance` otherwise; every `Text` leaf has a class and the
  opacity report breaks down by class (T-LCD-02). *Stage-1 cut:* the record + the check + the
  mandatory table + text-leaf classification land here; the HIR-node/edge wiring lands with
  HIR/1 `validate` at **S1.4** (tracked DF-S1.3-1).
- AC-2: property test over random derivation/delegation/persistence sequences with no
  endorsement events: no-upward-move without a legitimate endorsement; `join`/`meet`/`leq`
  satisfy the lattice laws.

Universal phase-gate AC: verification green; every new behaviour fail-if-removed tested; req ids
stamped; unverifiable → DEFERRALS row + compensating control; ADRs for deviations/owned
decisions; BUILD_INDEX row + LEDGER advanced.

Cross-cutting invariants re-checked: **CC1 anchors here** (one `ProvenanceRecord`, no second);
**CC2 anchors here** (authority derived by the minting table, never declared, never widened —
`AuthorityExceedsOrigin`, endorsement basis closed); CC3 (lowering loss declared, never silent);
CC4 (records language-neutral; this crate is the E1 build binding); CC8 (additive swap of the
identity provenance field).

## Plan
New persistent crate `crates/hh-provenance` — the C0/Stage-1 §8.1 model as a pure-std E1 build
binding (CC4), depending on `hh-wire` only. It must sit **below** `hh-identity` in the build
graph: `VersionedRef.provenance` becomes the canonical `ProvenanceRecord` (DF-S1.2-1), so
`hh-identity → hh-provenance`. Therefore ref-carrying fields inside provenance records carry
**identity coordinates** (`String` version ids / content addresses), never a `VersionedRef`
(a record embedded in `VersionedRef` cannot recursively contain it; the typed HIR `Ref<T>`
projection lands above, at S1.4).
Modules: `authority` (AuthorityClass total order, TaintTag, ReaderSet, PersistenceScope);
`origin` (Origin sum, `default_authority`, `default_text_authority`/R-TEXT); `label` (Label,
join/meet/leq, top, LabelDelta/P6, context_label, effective_authority); `record`
(ProvenanceRecord, Derivation, Attestation, validate/verify_attestation); `derive` (P1 +
subagent-result ingestion); `endorse` (EndorsementBasis closed six, endorse/declassify, seal,
security.label.* payloads, check-5 validation); `monitor` (checks 1/2/5/7 + minimal Permission);
`lower` (P7 hir/provenance carrier, lower/lift, LoweringLoss); `render` (RP render_role);
`mandatory` (mandatory-provenance event table + check_event_append; text-leaf/opacity helpers).
DF-S1.2-1 closure: `hh-identity::refs` drops its `Origin`/`Provenance` for the canonical types;
`publish` reads `publisher.authority == Principal` + attestation for widening and
`authority == Kernel` for `hh/`; `RevocationRecord` carries the canonical record; `hh-baseline`'s
throwaway `ProvenanceRecord`/`AuthorityClass` migrate onto `hh-provenance` (CC1: exactly one
ProvenanceRecord type in the tree). No new external deps (hermetic).
